instruction: Two Storey Duplex Townhouse IFC And Revit Plan Sheet PDF This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a pair of two-storey duplex townhouses, export the model as result.ifc, and export a two-page Revit plan sheet PDF as result.pdf in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.pdf; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.pdf is at least 200 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 10 IfcSpace entities, 16 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcRoof, 10 IfcDoor entities, 8 IfcWindow entities, and 2 IfcStair entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token living at least 2 times, kitchen at least 2 times, bedroom at least 4 times, and bath at least 2 times. 7. Result.pdf contains exactly 2 pages exported from Revit sheets. 8. The extracted text from result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 LEVEL 1 PLAN, A102 LEVEL 2 PLAN, Bedroom 1 A, and Bedroom 2 B. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
